The lower third is in `s3/index.html`, and `npx hyperframes check` reports no errors. It runs 4 seconds at 1920×1080: "Mohammed" and "Maintainer, Girth" slide in from the left and hold until the end.

- **Layout:** the bar, name and title sit in the lower left, inside the safe area. The name is Inter 700 at 80px and the title is 40px, so neither falls below the text-size floor.
- **Motion:** the bar and both lines slide in over about 0.8 seconds, with the title starting 0.2 seconds after the name. I kept the slide short (180px) so the text is already on screen at frame 0. My first version slid in from off-screen, and the check warned that frame 0 showed only the background.
- **Check warning:** one warning is left, about the bar being nested inside the lower-third container. I left it because the existing `s2` composition uses the same flat single-composition structure.
- **Record step:** I skipped the skill's "run `made`" step. There is no `girth` command on this machine, and `npx girth` couldn't find one, so I couldn't record it.
